description: C# and ASP.NET Core analyzers for the five baseline controls.

controls.title: Input validation
controls.description: ASP.NET Core model validation is active and not globally suppressed.

controls.title: Authentication
controls.description: Authentication is registered, invoked, and configured with secure cookie and token settings.

controls.title: Authorization
controls.description: Mutating endpoints require an authenticated principal or a deny-by-default policy.

controls.title: Injection prevention
controls.description: SQL and OS command sinks are parameterized and avoid dynamic command construction.

rules.title: Model validation globally suppressed
rules.message: SuppressModelStateInvalidFilter is enabled and no manual validation was detected.
rules.remediation: Remove the global suppression, or validate ModelState/FluentValidation explicitly before using the input.

rules.title: Authentication middleware not invoked
rules.message: Authentication services are registered but UseAuthentication is missing, so requests are not authenticated.
rules.remediation: Call app.UseAuthentication() before app.UseAuthorization() and before mapped endpoints.

rules.title: Cookie is not HttpOnly
rules.message: Cookie authentication sets HttpOnly to false, exposing the session cookie to script.

rules.title: Cookie SecurePolicy disabled
rules.message: Cookie authentication permits transmission over HTTP because SecurePolicy is None.
rules.remediation: Set Cookie.SecurePolicy = CookieSecurePolicy.Always outside local development.

rules.title: JWT metadata HTTPS disabled
rules.message: RequireHttpsMetadata is false, allowing token metadata retrieval over plain HTTP.
rules.remediation: Set RequireHttpsMetadata = true and use an HTTPS authority.

rules.title: Mutating endpoint is not authorized
rules.message: A mutating endpoint has no controller/action authorization and no deny-by-default fallback policy.
rules.remediation: Add [Authorize] or an explicit policy, or configure a fallback policy requiring authentication; document genuinely public endpoints.

rules.title: Dynamic SQL construction
rules.message: A SQL query is built with interpolation or concatenation instead of parameters.
rules.remediation: Use parameterized queries (SqlParameter/SqliteParameter/Parameters.Add), FromSqlInterpolated, or a parameter object for Dapper.

rules.title: Dynamic OS command construction
rules.message: An OS process is started with interpolated or concatenated arguments, allowing command injection.
rules.remediation: Use a fixed executable and ProcessStartInfo.ArgumentList; never invoke cmd.exe or a shell with untrusted input.

rules.title: Unresolved OS command arguments
rules.message: Process execution arguments could not be resolved statically and require manual review.
rules.remediation: Show a fixed executable and an ArgumentList constructed from validated values, or document why the command is not attacker-controlled.

rules.title: Unresolved SQL command
rules.message: A SQL command text comes from a variable or helper and cannot be proven constant or parameterized.
rules.remediation: Use a constant, parameterized command or FromSqlInterpolated; provide test evidence for any query builder.
